"''Ready as we'll ever be, Captain Syndulla.|Hera Syndulla and Phoenix Leader|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] flew under the [[callsign]] "'''[[Phoenix Leader]]'''" for [[Phoenix Cell]], an anti-[[Galactic Empire]] fleet composed of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s that operated under the command of [[Jun Sato]]. During [[4 BBY]], Phoenix Leader led the squadron in an attack against the Empire over the [[planet]] [[Ibaar]] in an attempt to break the Imperial's [[Blockade of Ibaar|planetary blockade]] and deliver relief supplies to Ibaar's starving populace. When the supply ship [[Transport One]] was destroyed by the Imperial defenses the rebels ordered a full retreat. However, the life of Phoenix Leader was [[Death|claimed]] by Imperial fire during the escape. Rebel [[pilot]] [[Hera Syndulla]] was later promoted as the human's successor after her participation in a second rebel strike against the blockade that proved successful. ==Biography== {{Quote|Just handle those TIEs, Phoenix Leader.''"
"''We'll cover you, ''Ghost''. Start you run.|Hera Syndulla and Phoenix Leader|}} During the [[Standard year|year]] [[4 BBY]] a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was a member of [[Phoenix Cell]], a small fleet of [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor]]s under the leadership of [[Commander]] [[Jun Sato]]. The squadron opposed the rule of the [[Galactic Empire]], and joined a rebel network led by Imperial [[senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa|Bail Organa]] and ex-[[Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano]]. Sometime after the [[Siege of Lothal]], the human male [[pilot]] served [[Phoenix Squadron]] as [[Phoenix Leader]]. [[File:Phoenix_Leader_craft.png|thumb|left|200px|Phoenix Leader died over Ibaar after being caught by enemy fire.]] As Phoenix Leader, he participated in a [[Blockade of Ibaar|mission to deliver food]] to the Imperial occupied [[planet]] [[Ibaar]], as an Imperial [[blockade]] cut off the planet's ability to receive off world resources needed for the world's populace to survive. The rebels' plan was to storm the blockade and send a transport loaded with food down to Ibaar's surface, where it would be received by local [[miner]] [[Eesh Fahm]]. Phoenix Leader and four other A-Wing starfighters joined the [[CR90 corvette]] [[Transport One]], the chosen supply vessel, and the [[starship]] ''[[Ghost]]'', [[captain]]ed by the [[Twi'lek]] [[Hera Syndulla]], in the mission. After initially engaging the Imperial blockade, the Imperial commander, [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau]], opened a communications line and ordered the approaching rebels to disperse. Instead, Syndulla and Phoenix Leader engaged the Imperial ships. Syndulla ordered Phoenix Leader to concentrate on the Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] and cover the ''Ghost'', which Phoenix Leader promised to do. Despite the rebels destroying several TIE fighters in the ensuing fight, the skirmish turned towards the Empire's favor when Transport One was destroyed. The order to retreat was given, and Phoenix Leader had his men fall back. However, Phoenix Leader's escape was cut short by Imperial fire. News of his [[death]] spread through the rebel comm channels, and the remainder of Phoenix Squadron escaped the [[Star system|system]]. Despite the initial failure, Syndulla returned to Ibaar with an [[Prototype B6|experimental starfighter loaded with advanced weapons]] and helped the rebel forces break through the blockade and deliver food to the planet's populace. For her actions, Syndulla was promoted as the new Phoenix Leader. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|We have to get out of here!|Phoenix Leader, shortly before his death|}} Phoenix Leader was a human male with light-[[color]]ed skin and blue [[eye]]s. When Syndulla asked whether or not Phoenix Leader was ready for the assault on the Imperial blockade, Phoenix Leader acknowledged that he and his men were ready for the mission at hand. Phoenix Leader was a capable pilot, and fought Imperial fighters off during the early stages of the mission. However, he was unable to out-maneuver enemy fire as he made his retreat. While piloting his A-wing, Phoenix Leader wore a green [[Clothing|jumpsuit]] and a beige helmet. His A-wing had blue, white, and red markings across it. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|All fighters, attack formation!|Phoenix Leader orders his men to attack|}} Phoenix Leader first appeared in "[[Wings of the Master]]," the fifth episode of [[Star Wars Rebels Season Two|season two]] of the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' television series. Phoenix Leader's voice was provided by [[Steve Blum]], who also provided the voice for series regular [[Garazeb Orrelios]]. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|Wings of the Master}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|rlWwFVVV0_s|Blockade Busters - Wings of the Master Preview | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/star-wars-rebels-blockade-busters}} *{{RebelsRecon|Jdj4teY5gik|#2.06: Inside "Wings of the Master" | Star Wars Rebels|sw_url=video/rebels-recon-inside-wings-of-the-master}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Phönix 1 (Ibaar) |fr=Phoenix Leader (Ibaar) |ja=フェニックス・リーダー（アイバー） }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Phoenix 01}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]] [[Category:Phoenix Squadron personnel]]
